reader_summary.headline: Today we are getting into the world of coffee with Gregory Zamfotis, the founder of Gregorys Coffee.
reader_summary.overview: Today we are getting into the world of coffee with Gregory Zamfotis, the founder of Gregorys Coffee. We breakdown the New York City born coffee chain that now spans across twelve US states. This is a true look into what it takes to open up a coffee shop and the economics behind it.

key_points.text: We get into what it's like to innovate in an industry where innovation can last a week before a competitor releases the same thing on their menu..
And Greg also shares all of the challenges around going from one store to a second store to scaling into what Gregorys is today.
Please enjoy this Breakdown of Gregorys coffee.
